title: AnalysisExecutionRequest
description: Backend → AI Service request body, POSTed to {AI_SERVICE_URL}/v1/analysis/execute (handled by ai-service/api/entry.py). RESOLVED: §103 documents both AI-Service-to-Backend internal paths (/internal/v1/progress, /internal/v1/result) but never names this reverse direction — this path is a project decision, not a doc fact. No /api prefix since ai-service is never Frontend-facing (§102's communication rule). Write this into §103 or a new subsection alongside the internal paths. §99.1, §102

analysis_id.description: RESOLVED: req_{YYYYMMDD}_{HHMM}_{hash6}, matching your locked contract convention (confirmed against your own old worked-example file) rather than the doc's illustrative 'an_7f3c...' (§20.1, §38). YYYYMMDD_HHMM is the request RECEIPT time in UTC, not the target analysis window — the target window is often unresolved at ID-generation time (e.g. 'tomorrow morning' isn't parsed until the Planner runs, which happens after the Backend must already have assigned an id). hash6 = 6 lowercase alphanumeric chars for uniqueness within the same minute.

alert_subscription_id.description: Present when this analysis was triggered by the alert scheduler. §8, §70.1
